name: io.github.launzi/tvsub-mcp
title: tvsub MCP
description: Control tvsub for macOS Apple TV.app: subtitle selection, glossary-aware translation via Anthropic API or Claude/ChatGPT subscription CLIs, provenance, dual-subtitle styling, overlay, and sync.

packageArguments.name: --tvsub-root
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to the installed tvsub directory

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key; required only for subtitle translation
